name: payguard
description: Payment guard for AI agents on NEAR: checks every payment before it goes out and blocks bad ones, with a reason.

scripts.test: npm run test:reference && npm run test:contract && npm run test:deployment && npm run test:runner && npm run test:evidence
scripts.build: near-sdk-js build contract/guard.ts build/guard.wasm && node scripts/check-exports.mjs
scripts.test:sandbox: npm run build && npm run build:fixture && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/sandbox.test.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run check && npm run test:sandbox
